name: Umbral Crown: Mark
source:
Leviathan receives an order from the Fortress: infiltrate Pandemonium and eliminate Wrath, the ruthless traitor. Prove yourself, sea dragon.

[From [url=https://watermelonowl.itch.io/umbral-crown-mark]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
利維坦收到要塞傳來的命令：潛入萬魔殿，除掉冷酷無情的叛徒「暴怒」。海龍，證明你的本事吧。

［摘自[url=https://watermelonowl.itch.io/umbral-crown-mark]Itch.io[/url]］
